title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
朱元璋和马秀英在洪武二年的时候追封马太公为徐王，在太庙东侧建祠，当时是马秀英亲自奉安神主。在宿州的丰山左侧、龟山右侧的夹沟镇北有一座陵园，这就是徐王陵。不过现在这里只是圈了地，还没有建坟立庙。此刻的驿站之内，一个黑瘦的青年忧心忡忡的在喂着一头瘦骨嶙峋的驴。“吃、就知道吃！我们两现在大祸临头了！”瘦驴抬起头，昂昂的叫唤两声，然后继续大快朵颐。“我不是皇后同父异母的弟弟，肯定逃不了扒皮挫骨的下场，说不定会千刀万剐。你也在劫难逃，要给做成驴肉火烧！天上龙肉、地上驴肉，知道吗？”瘦驴不管不顾，继续在大快朵颐，难得有这么美味的草料。马寻就更加忧心忡忡了，“老头怎么就是皇后她爹了？不是说皇后没有兄弟姊妹吗？老头逃难，背着人命案，还有心思娶妻生子？”想到这里，马寻就更加担心了，他的姐夫疑似是洪武皇帝！摸了摸瘦驴旺财的脑袋，马寻非常惆怅，“哎，你说如果老头真的是徐王，皇后认不认我这个同父异母的弟弟？认了的话，有没有机会给我封候拜将？”下一刻马寻摇头，“不太可能，她是贤后。我没功劳，而且还是异母弟，说难听点就是私生子，能认就不错了，哪能给安排个官职呢！”不过想想也不绝对，这个年代不讲究小三小四，这又不是在外宅养的。“你说这古代还真的是厉害，人死了还真不是随便找个地就能埋了。山是有主的，地也是有主的，怪不得皇帝要封刘继祖为义惠侯。”早知道悄悄的找个地给老头埋了就好，落叶归根、落叶归根，现在可倒好，他给直接控制起来了！如果身份得到了认可还好，一旦不认可，那就是生不如死了！就算是喂个驴，不远处还站着好几个挎着刀的护卫。换了身还不错的衣裳，这两天也吃住不愁，但是谁知道会不会是最后的晚餐呢！就在说话间，一个身材魁梧、浓眉大眼的中年人阔步走进驿站。宿州到应天府差不多三百公里，朱元璋花了一天一夜疾驰而来。看到那个在喂着驴的青年，朱元璋愣了一下。又高又瘦、还是杂乱的短发，身上穿着锦袍还松松垮垮显得非常不合身，显然是刚借来穿的。朱元璋上前，笑着问道，“你就是马寻？”看着气场强大的朱元璋，马寻谨慎问道，“您哪位？”朱元璋含糊说道，“本家兄弟都认不得了？”马寻立刻吐槽的说道，“能认识才怪，先前见了几个外家，就是武忠、武聚几个。认也不敢认我，谁知道我到底是哪家的！”武忠、武聚，也就是马秀英的表兄弟，是马秀英舅舅的两个儿子。

马寻看了看朱元璋，小心问道，“您这一看就是大人物，怎么前两天没见着？”朱元璋拍了拍旺财的脑袋说道，“先前不在宿州，急忙急火的赶了回来。这驴两岁了，就是它拖着徐王棺椁回来的？”“可遭了不少罪，还没长成呢。”马寻有些心疼的说道，“这位大哥，真要是出了差错，这驴您牵走。它有灵性、聪明，别让人给宰了吃肉。”朱元璋看着马寻问道，“差错，能有什么差错？”“我都搞不清老头到底是什么身份，怎么就和皇帝皇后沾亲了？”马寻立刻吐苦水，“您肯定是大人物，说不准能在皇后面前说上话，对吧？”朱元璋立刻摇头说道，“俺在皇后那说不上话，你既然说不知先人身份，为何送他回来？”“还不是落叶归根、入土为安，不管怎么说也是他儿子。”马寻就说道，“大哥，我真不是要攀附皇亲。就是将老头给埋到祖坟，哪知道给人逮了。我悄摸着呢，真不怪我！”朱元璋冷哼一声，“没打死你是轻的！徐王祖茔岂能轻动！”马寻更委屈了，“没在那边，我隔了老远，哪知道也给圈进去了。”朱元璋不置可否，随即问道，“皇后是新丰里人，你又姓马，怎么就不觉得自己是皇后兄弟？”马寻知道眼前这人肯定是派来查案的，所以更加谨慎，“不是说皇后没有兄弟吗？这天下姓马的人多了，哪能和皇后沾亲。而且岁数也差了不少，哪能是姐弟。”“既然知晓皇后没有兄弟姊妹，还是新丰里人，你扶棺回来，不是寻亲是什么？”朱元璋锐利的眼神盯着马寻，“看你谈吐，读过书？”马寻谨慎回答，“读过，但是读书不知其意，字写的也不好。”看了眼马寻的头发，朱元璋问道，“当过和尚？”“哪有福气当和尚，没度牒混口饭吃。”马寻有些尴尬的抓了抓乱糟糟的头发，“大哥，我这么称呼没错吧？”朱元璋就笑着说道，“皇后要是认你，你这么称呼倒是没错，没差辈。”这就是大人物了，和皇后还是一个辈分的，还了解一些皇后的家世，那可了不得。朱元璋收敛笑容，随即问道，“先人故去多少年了？就他一个回来了？”“十年了。”马寻就笑着说道，“棺椁都差不多了，还好能收拾一下，娘亲的遗骨不知老头埋哪了。”朱元璋心里一哆嗦，连忙问道，“你今年多大？”马寻老实回答，“二十。”
content_en:
In the second year of Hongwu, Zhu Yuanzhang and Ma Xiuying posthumously granted Ma Taigong the title of King Xu and built a temple on the east side of the Taimiao Temple. At that time, Ma Xiuying personally enshrined the Lord An.There is a cemetery in the north of Jiagou Town on the left side of Fengshan Mountain and the right side of Guishan Mountain in Suzhou. This is the Mausoleum of King Xu.But now the land is just enclosed and no tombs or temples have been built yet.At this moment, in the inn, a dark and thin young man was feeding a skinny donkey worriedly."Eat, just eat! Now we are both in great danger!" The thin donkey raised its head, brayed twice, and then continued to feast."I am not the Queen's half-brother. I will definitely not escape the fate of being skinned and bruised, and I may be cut into pieces. You are also doomed, and will be made into donkey meat and burned! Dragon meat in the sky, donkey meat on the ground, you know?" The thin donkey ignored it and continued to feast. It is rare to have such delicious fodder.Ma Xun became even more worried, "Why is the old man the queen's father? Didn't it mean that the queen had no brothers and sisters? The old man was on the run, carrying a murder case, and still wanted to marry a wife and have children?" Thinking of this, Ma Xun became even more worried. His brother-in-law was suspected to be Emperor Hongwu!After touching the head of the thin donkey Wangcai, Ma Xun felt very melancholy, "Hey, if the old man is really King Xu, will the queen recognize me as my half-brother? If so, will there be a chance to make me a general?" The next moment, Ma Xun shook his head, "That's not possible.Yes, she is a virtuous queen.I have no merit, and she is also a half-brother. To put it bluntly, she is an illegitimate child. It would be great if she can recognize her.How can she be given an official position?" But thinking about it, it is not certain. This era does not pay attention to mistresses and mistresses, and this is not a child raised outside the house."You said that ancient times are really powerful. When people die, they can't just find a place to bury them. Mountains have owners, and the land also has owners. No wonder the emperor wants to make Liu Jizu the Marquis of Yihui." If he had known better, he would have quietly found a place to bury the old man. Fallen leaves return to their roots, fallen leaves return to their roots, but now it's better, he has direct control!It's okay if the identity is recognized, but if it is not recognized, it will be worse than death!Even if he was just feeding a donkey, there were still several guards standing not far away with knives in their hands.I have changed into nice clothes, and I have no worries about food and accommodation for these two days, but who knows if it will be the last supper!While he was talking, a tall, middle-aged man with thick eyebrows and big eyes strode into the inn.It was almost three hundred kilometers from Suzhou to Yingtianfu, and Zhu Yuanzhang spent a whole day and night galloping there.Seeing the young man feeding the donkey, Zhu Yuanzhang was stunned for a moment.He was tall, thin, with messy short hair, and he was wearing a loose brocade robe that looked very ill-fitting. He had obviously just borrowed it.Zhu Yuanzhang stepped forward and asked with a smile, "Are you Ma Xun?" Looking at the powerful Zhu Yuanzhang, Ma Xun asked cautiously, "Who are you?" Zhu Yuanzhang said vaguely, "Can't even my brothers recognize you?" Ma Xun immediately complained,"It's strange that we know each other. I met a few maternal relatives before, including Wuzhong and Wuju. They didn't dare to recognize me. Who knows which family I am from!" Wuzhong and Wuju, Ma Xiuying's cousins, are the two sons of Ma Xiuying's uncle.

Ma Xun looked at Zhu Yuanzhang and asked cautiously, "You look like a big shot. Why didn't you see me two days ago?" Zhu Yuanzhang patted Wangcai on the head and said, "I was not in Suzhou before, so I came back in a hurry. This donkey is two years old. Is it the one who dragged King Xu's coffin back?" "But he has suffered a lot."Sin, it's not mature yet."Ma Xun said with some distress, "Brother, if something goes wrong, please take this donkey away. It's intelligent and smart, so don't let it be slaughtered for meat."Zhu Yuanzhang looked at Ma Xun and asked, "What's wrong?""I can't figure out the identity of the old man?", why are you related to the emperor and the empress?" Ma Xun immediately complained, "You must be a big shot, you can't possibly speak in front of the empress, right?" Zhu Yuanzhang immediately shook his head and said, "I can't speak to the empress.Since you said you don't know the identity of the ancestor, why did you send him back?" "Isn't it Luo?"Ye Guigen, he is still his son after all." Ma Xun said, "Brother, I really didn't want to bury the old man in the ancestral grave.How could I be caught?" Zhu Yuanzhang snorted, "Isn't it easy for you to be killed?"You can move lightly!" Ma Xun was even more aggrieved, "I wasn't there, I was so far away, so I didn't know that I was trapped." Zhu Yuanzhang was noncommittal, and then asked, "The queen is from Xinfengli, and your surname is Ma, why don't you think that you are the queen's brother?" Ma Xun knew that the person in front of him must be sent to investigate the case., so he was more cautious, "Didn't you say that the queen has no brothers? There are so many people with the surname Ma in the world, how can they be related to the queen? And there is a big age difference, how can they be siblings." "Since we know that the queen has no brothers and sisters, and she is still from Xinfengli, if you come back with a coffin, what else can you do if you are not looking for relatives?" Zhu Yuanzhang saidHe stared at Ma Xun with sharp eyes, "Looking at your conversation, have you read the book?" Ma Xun answered cautiously, "I have, but I don't know the meaning of the book, and the handwriting is not good." Looking at Ma Xun's hair, Zhu Yuanzhang asked, "Have you ever been a monk?" "How can you be lucky enough to be a monk? You don't have to earn a living." Ma Xun was a little embarrassed.He scratched his messy hair in embarrassment, "Brother, am I right to call you that?" Zhu Yuanzhang said with a smile, "If the queen recognizes you, you are right to call her that. You are no different." This is a big shot. He is the same generation as the queen, and he also knows some of the queen's family background, which is amazing.Zhu Yuanzhang stopped his smile and asked immediately, "How many years has it been since my ancestor died? Is he the only one who has come back?" "Ten years." Ma Xun said with a smile, "The coffins are almost there. It's a good thing we can clean them up. I don't know where the old man buried my mother's remains." Zhu Yuanzhang trembled in his heart and asked quickly, "How old are you this year?" Ma Xun answered honestly, "Twenty."
